items.raw_excerpt: 在 AI 技术的推波助澜下，高危内核 CVE 以周级频率爆发，系统修复面临前所未有的压力。尽管内核热补丁技术克服了传统修复需重启服务器的弊端，实现了业务零中断，但从上游原始 Patch 到可加载热补丁的转化过程，仍依赖大量繁琐的人工改写。

title_i18n.zh: 如何利用 AI Agent 实现热补丁的自动化生成
title_i18n.en: How to use AI Agent to automate hot patch generation
title_i18n.es: Cómo usar un agente de IA para la generación automática de parches en caliente.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在 AI 技术的推波助澜下，高危内核 CVE 以周级频率爆发，系统修复面临前所未有的压力。尽管内核热补丁技术克服了传统修复需重启服务器的弊端，实现了业务零中断，但从上游原始 Patch 到可加载热补丁的转化过程，仍依赖大量繁琐的人工改写。
excerpt_i18n.en: Driven by AI technology, high-risk kernel CVEs are erupting at a weekly frequency, placing unprecedented pressure on system fixes. Although kernel hot patching overcomes the drawback of traditional fixes requiring server reboots, achieving zero business interruption, the conversion process from upstream original patches to loadable hot patches still relies on extensive tedious manual rewriting.
excerpt_i18n.es: Con el impulso de la tecnología de IA, las CVEs críticas del kernel estallan con una frecuencia semanal, y la reparación del sistema enfrenta una presión sin precedentes. Aunque la tecnología de parches en caliente del kernel supera el inconveniente tradicional de requerir reinicios del servidor, logrando una interrupción cero del negocio, el proceso de conversión desde el parche original upstream hasta el parche en caliente cargable aún depende de una gran cantidad de tediosas reescrituras manuales.

items.title: Text AI watermarks will always be trivial to remove
items.raw_excerpt: The European Union AI Act will begin to be enforceable in August 2026, one month from now 1 . One of the biggest new requirements is Article 50 , which requires all AI outputs to be “detectable as artificially generated”. excerpt_i18n.en: Looking back at highlights from past soccer matches, editors used to review footage, find goals, celebrations, slow-motion replays, and audience reactions, then slice, package, add subtitles, and finally distribute to different platforms. The process was long, labor-intensive, and whether it could catch the traffic from a trending moment depended on experience and speed. Now this workflow has been dismantled and reassembled, with models and toolchains taking over the entire production process of match highlights. In the new workflow, AI can understand live streams in real time, identify signals such as camera cuts, audio changes, player celebrations, and referee whistles, quickly return highlight clips after key events, and generate independent, distributable slices. By the time a moment goes viral, the video is already ready. The change behind this is not just that a single tool has become more efficient; it is that the production of audio and video content is evolving from a human-driven workflow to an Agent-driven workflow. This not only involves calling models to generate and process audio-visual content, but also creates new production tools and new workflows based on that, truly approaching the ideal state of "one sentence to produce a finished video." This paradigm shift in video production requires support from a new technical foundation. items.title: 物理 AI 到来，移动网络该如何进化？
items.raw_excerpt: 过去一年，几乎所有人都在追问同一个问题： AI 大模型还能变得多聪明？Agent、多模态、端侧部署，构成了 AI 产业最热闹的叙事。 但当 AI 开始进入眼镜、汽车、机器人、摄像头这些物理载体，开始在道路、工厂、家庭和人类交互之后，我们发现，现实世界和 AI 大模型之间，还有最后一公里的路没有打通。 AI 眼镜要识别眼前的文字，Robotaxi 要判断周围路况，机器人要决定下一步动作。它们依赖的不只是算法，也包括图像、语音、位置、空间关系、设备状态和环境变化等数据。 这些数据需要先由终端采集，再通过网络上传，交给云端或边缘侧模型处理。模型输出的结果，也要通过网络返回终端，才能转化现实中的业务动作。 这使得移动网络在 AI 时代承担了新的压力。 过去，网络波动可能只是让视频缓冲几秒；未来，同样的波动可能导致实时识别失败、远程控制迟滞，或者智能体无法完成动作。 移动网络不再只是单纯的内容分发通道。它需要识别连接对象，理解业务类型，判断实时性要求，也要在资源紧张时决定哪些连接需要优先保障。 物理 AI 时代的网络，不能只是一条“更宽的管道”。 移动网络的下一批用户，不只是人类 很长一段时间里，移动通信网络服务的核心对象是人。 在语音时代，网络解决的是通话连接，让人在移动状态下完成实时沟通。进入 3G、4G 时代后，智能手机和在线内容快速普及，移动网络的主要任务转向大带宽数据传输。网页、图片、音乐、视频、直播、游戏和在线会议，成为了移动互联网时代最典型的业务形态。 智能手机也在这个过程中变成了高度集成的入口。过去由独立设备完成的功能，例如 GPS、音乐播放器、相机、录音机和部分办公工具，逐渐被手机吸收到一个终端里。移动互联网时代的一个基本特征，是终端形态向手机集中，人则是最主要的连接主体。 AI 的到来改变了这个前提。 大模型要理解现实世界，首先需要获得更丰富、更连续的现实输入。图

excerpt_i18n.zh: 雷峰网讯 过去一周，AI 开发者圈讨论的焦点，已经不只是谁又发布了更强的模型，而是一个更现实的问题， 谁还能稳定地调用到最强的模型？ 随着美国对于 Fable 5 调用的限制，顶级闭源模型的可获得性终于成为了悬在开发者头上的不确定因素。特别是对于已经把大模型深度接入代码生成、Agent 工作流和企业应用的团队来说，一个模型哪怕性能再强，只要存在访问受限、策略调整、价格波动或突然下架的风险，就跟“可靠的基础设施”不沾边了。 OpenRouter 给出了一种解法，即不要押注单一最佳模型，而是通过多模型协作和模型路由，在不同任务之间动态切换能力最合适的模型。这代表了应用层的一种新趋势，当最强模型不可控时，开发者开始追求可替代、可组合、可持续的模型系统。 就在这个背景下，6 月 17 日 GLM-5.2 的发布格外触动神经。 硅谷最顶级的风投机构之 一 a16z 的联合创始人 Marc Andreessen 在 十天后 于 X 上发文称，「许多聪明人和 AI 圈内人认为，GLM-5.2 是第一个能够无妥协地匹敌、甚至超越美国大实验室公开模型的中国 AI」，并特别点出：「时机妙极，恰逢当下。」 这句评价更重要的意义 或许在于，他转述的，正是硅谷圈子里正在形成的共识—开源的中国模型，在能力上做到了和美国顶级实验室同台竞技。 根据智谱 AI 官方文档，GLM-5.2 整体表现介于 Claude Opus 4.7 与 Opus 4.8 之间，在 FrontierSWE 等长程编程任务上表现尤其突出，仅落后 Opus 4.8 约 1%，同时超过 GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.7。 另有社区讨论也将其视为目前开源模型阵营中，最接近顶级闭源模型的一次跃迁。马斯克预测智谱大模型大约在 2027 年 Q1 达到 Fable 5，唐杰本人亲自下场回复：用不了那么久。 在一个顶级模型供给越来越不稳定
excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past week, the focus of discussion among AI developers has shifted from who released a more powerful model to a more practical question: who can still stably access the most powerful models? With the U.S. restricting calls to Fable 5, the availability of top-tier closed-source models has become an uncertainty hanging over developers. Especially for teams that have deeply integrated large models into code generation, agent workflows, and enterprise applications, no matter how strong a model's performance is, if it carries risks of restricted access, policy adjustments, price fluctuations, or sudden removal, it cannot be considered "reliable infrastructure." OpenRouter offers one solution: instead of betting on a single best model, leverage multi-model collaboration and model routing to dynamically switch to the most suitable model for different tasks. This represents a new trend in the application layer: when the strongest models are uncontrollable, developers begin to pursue replaceable, composable, and sustainable model systems. Against this backdrop, the release of GLM-5.2 on June 17 struck a particular nerve. Ten days later, Marc Andreessen, co-founder of a16z, one of Silicon Valley's top venture capital firms, posted on X: "Many smart people and AI insiders believe GLM-5.2 is the first Chinese AI that can match or even surpass public models from major U.S. labs without compromise," and specifically noted: "Perfect timing, right now."

excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng News: It’s hard to regard Coding as just one of the many capability dimensions of large models. Compared with pure text or image generation, the clearer rules, stricter syntax, and verifiable results of code are only part of the reason. More uniquely, along the evolutionary chain from ChatBot to Agent, Coding involves tool invocation, data processing, and complex workflow automation—it carries most of the expectations for models to transition from “talking” to “doing.” A noteworthy change is that Coding is standing out from dazzling benchmark rankings and becoming an infrastructure-level metric for model competition. Whether OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or other vendors, almost all choose Coding scenarios to showcase their muscles when releasing new models. In a sense, this is an emerging industry consensus: code capability not only represents programming skill but also serves as an important angle to measure a model’s logical reasoning, tool usage, and actual productivity. We’re also curious how far domestic models have evolved in this fiercely competitive Coding track. To that end, we selected five domestic models known for their coding prowess—DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K2.6, Qwen 3.7 Max, GLM 5.1, and MiniMax M3—and put them into the same real engineering task.
excerpt_i18n.es: Leifeng Net: Es difícil considerar Coding solo como una de las muchas dimensiones de capacidad de los grandes modelos. En comparación con la generación de texto o imágenes simples, las reglas más claras, la sintaxis estricta y los resultados verificables del código son solo parte de la razón. Lo que es más especial es que, en la cadena evolutiva de ChatBot a Agent, Coding implica llamadas a herramientas, procesamiento de datos y automatización de procesos complejos, cargando casi todas las expectativas de que el modelo pase de "saber hablar" a "saber hacer". Un cambio digno de atención es que Coding está destacándose de la deslumbrante lista de Benchmark para convertirse en una competencia de modelos.
